verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because Windmill ships AI Agent flow steps that could plausibly consume external MCP tools. However, the pack only documents Windmill acting as an MCP server, letting clients like Claude or Cursor trigger its scripts and flows. That is the opposite role and does not count for this client-side story. The AI Agent docs mention connecting to AI providers and models, not plugging in external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
